mentions.name: Globs
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game where players find the hidden theme behind a jumble of tiles. Puzzle groups are generated by AI, which the creator says keeps coming up with surprising themes. It supports demos in over 20 languages, daily generated puzzles for American English, British English, High German and European Spanish, multiple puzzle sizes, and custom theme puzzles such as "Big YC" and "Jumbo HN". It was inspired by thomaswc's 45x45 connections-like puzzle "2025".
